import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to stabilize after previous actions
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Select the first available template radio button to proceed with template selection
    await page.get_by_role("tabpanel").get_by_role("radio", name="Use template").first.click()
    # Fill in the project name as 'AGISite'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name").fill("AGISite")
    # Click the 'Create project' button to create the project
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
